question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is "**components**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Blank no. 2** is asking for a word that fits in the sentence "**Soil includes a huge amount of both organic and inorganic _____**."
 
• The correct answer is "**components**," which refers to the **parts or substances that make up something**.
